posts.author: ravindra12
posts.community: IDFC First Bank Limited - First Bank Preference for Long Term Investors too?
posts.text: Today’s fall in IDFC bank price seems purely due to VV’s habit of presenting things differently in order to be extra careful/honest/xyz. Compare the data disclosed today by Kotak bank and IDFC bank - its clearly visible. Kotak is showing actual figures, and then adding a note that the figures include FCNR impact. IDFC on the other hand showing figures excluding FCNR impact and then adding a note showing what it would be if FCNR was included, thus showing smaller growth figures as headline and leaving the actual raw data as a qualifier note.
